versions.changelog:
- Clarified the skill's audience as AI agents assisting humans.
- Improved description for better context in automations and agent use cases.
- No changes to commands or output. All functionality remains the same.

Initial release – Lookup anime info using the Jikan API (unofficial MyAnimeList).

- Search for anime titles and retrieve details (title, episodes, score, etc.).
- Get full info by MyAnimeList ID, including synopsis, genres, and trailer.
- Browse top-ranked, upcoming, and current or specific seasonal anime.
- No account or API key required; works directly from the command line.
- Supports easy, human-friendly commands (e.g., "anime top 10", "anime search 'Frieren'").
